buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder must quote rate after study of estimated schedule of rate and quantity (PDF attached). 2. Bidder must fill the entire format/annexure attached as PDF. 3. Eligibility criteria will be as per tender document (attached as PDF). 4. Bid Governed by Railway GCC of Service contract 2018 attached as PDF. 5. Bidder should read the entire attached Tender document (PDF) before submitting t he bid. Bid will be finalize according the Tender documents. 6. Bidder should submit EMD as per GCC-03/2018 for service contract (item no-3.3). Bidders can submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out in the name of SR.DFM/WCR/Bhopal. Bidder has to upload scan ned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the Buyer within 5 d ays of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date. If bidder does not submit hard copy of FDR within 5 days of Bid En d date/ Bid Opening date, then bid will be treated as without EMD. Bid without EMD will not be considere d and summarily rejected. As per Railway Board letter No-2010/RS(G)/363/1 Dated 05.07.2012 MSEs registered with below mentioned agancies for the item tendered will be exempted from payment of earnest mon ey. Otherwise exemption of EMD will not be given to the firm. i) District Industries Centers ii) Khadi and Village Industries Commission iii) Khadi and Village Industries Board iv) Coir Board v) National Small Industries Corporation vi) Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom vii) Any other body specified by Ministry of MSME And MSE firm who upload MSME certificate issued by Ministry of MSME in Relevant category “Housek eeping/Cleaning/Catering" or all of them” will be exempted from submission of earnest money dep osit. Note:- Bidder must upload documents related to EMD exemption. Otherwise EMD exemption will not be given. . 7. Bidder will submit Annexure B1, B and XVIII after filling in standard format 8. Before quoting rate bidder has to visit site and analysis th e manpower requirement for the work and read tender doc ument carefully. Other Conditions:-This being a service contract hence, latest GCC (General Cond ition of Contract) of Service 2018 Contract of Indian Railway shall be applicable to thi s tender. In case of any ambiguity between STC, SLA, ATC, GTC of GeM and GCC of S ervice contract of Railway than GCC of service contract of Railway will prevail. .
